frozen_populations.agsi_definition: An ACTION-GATING STATE ITEM (AGSI) is a (anchor, field_name) pair whose value is (a) the value attribute of an <input>, <textarea> or <select> belonging to a <form> whose method is not GET; or (b) the content attribute of a <meta> whose name is in the frozen capability-token name list. Gating is STRUCTURAL; write verbs are forbidden.
frozen_populations.agsi_instance_key: (anchor_id, field_name, structure_signature) plus a document-order occurrence ordinal. A key contributes guard trials iff its occurrence count is IDENTICAL in the recorded session and in every current session it is paired with; unequal-count keys are EXCLUDED and counted in M-N-AGSI-EXCLUDED-UNSTABLE.
frozen_populations.recovered_value_definition: The recovered exact value is the literal attribute string after HTML entity decoding, byte-for-byte; empty string means PRESENT-EMPTY; absent attribute or field means ABSENT. Comparison is byte-exact.
frozen_populations.session_scoped_qualification: An anchor's AGSI (per path) qualifies SESSION-SCOPED iff HTTP 200 in >=3 of 4 sessions AND n_distinct_exact_values >= 2 AND n_distinct_body_sha256 >= 2.
frozen_populations.anchor_verdict_rule: Per anchor and per path: RECOVERED_SESSION_SCOPED if >=2 distinct non-empty exact values and the session-scoped criterion holds; RECOVERED_INVARIANT if exactly 1 distinct non-empty exact value; RECOVERED_EMPTY if in-list fields present but all empty/absent; NO_FIELD if no in-list field present; UNREACHABLE if HTTP 200 in <3 sessions. Anchor verdict is the pair (verdict_A, verdict_B), AGREED iff equal.
frozen_populations.trial_population: All ordered recorded/current session pairs (Sr, Sc) with r < c among S1..S4 (6 pairs), for every included AGSI instance. The S1 -> {S2,S3,S4} subset is reported separately for continuity.

decision_rule: ORDERED, FAIL-CLOSED. Every branch is pre-labelled MEASUREMENT_INVALID, DATA-INSUFFICIENT, BOUNDED NEGATIVE, or VALID RESULT; no branch converts a missing or invalid measurement into a scientific negative. PRE-FREEZE PRECONDITION (discharged in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run): the corrected GATE-C3 predicate and every declared membership class must be REACHABLE on pinned synthetic inputs before freeze. GATE C (pre-confirmatory certificate): C1 M-CERT-ROUTE-OK >= 3 of 4 AND M-CERT-FIELD-PRESENT >= 3 of 4; C2 M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-A == 0 AND M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-B == 0; C3 M-CERT-SESSION-ISOLATION-PASS == true AND NC-CONSTCONFIG-EXCLUSION-NOT-VACUOUS == true. Any C1/C2/C3 failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome INCONCLUSIVE, branch F-CERT. C4 (non-blocking) M-CERT-BODY-VARIABLE < 3 => status COMPLETE, outcome INCONCLUSIVE, branch NO-BODY-VARIATION. GATE F (estimator capability, NEW, before any GATE-B read): M-ESTIMATOR-POSITIVE-CONTROL-PASS == true AND NC-ESTIMATOR-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY passes. Any failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE, branch F-ESTIMATOR, and NO degeneracy/feasibility claim may be drawn. GATE E (after GATE C): E1 M-CANARY-PASS == true; E2 M-FIXTURE-CANARY-PASS == true AND M-FIXTURE-EMPTY-AGREE == true AND M-FIXTURE-JSSTRING-VALUES == 0 AND M-GUARD-FIXTURE-PASS == true AND NC-PATH-INDEPENDENCE == true AND NC-TRIAL-CONSTRUCTION-STABILITY == true. Any E1/E2 failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE, branch F-INSTR. E3 M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VALUESET >= 3 AND M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VERDICT >= 3. If E3 FAILS => status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED, branch EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE (M-N-EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE >= 2); no substrate verdict. If E3 PASSES: D1 M-N-SESSION-SCOPED-CONFIRMED >= 3 of 4 => status COMPLETE, outcome SUPPORTS, branch EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED (Part I replication). Else D2 M-N-REPRESENTATION-LOSS >= 3 of 4 => status COMPLETE, outcome FALSIFIES, branch REPRESENTATION-LOSS-CONFIRMED (bounded). Else D3 => status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED, branch MIXED-ANCHORS. GATE B (PART II, read ONLY if D1 AND GATE F passed): if M-N-D1V < 6 OR M-N-DECISIONS-D1V < 2 OR M-N-D1V-ANCHORS < 2 OR NC-NONDEGENERATE-ESTIMATOR fails (after waiver) OR the realized clustered interval is degenerate (LOW == UB97): if M-N-D1V-ANCHORS < 2 => branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE with M-D1V-DEGENERACY-MODE = ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_COUPLING (iff every VALUE-BEARING non-D1V anchor has a transport blocker in {BODY_DERIVED_ETAG, TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL}; NO_FIELD/UNREACHABLE anchors are counted separately and do not disqualify) else ANCHOR_SCARCITY_OTHER; else if the D1V-bearing anchors have identical realized paired false-accept differences (LOW == UB97) => branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE with M-D1V-DEGENERACY-MODE=ANCHOR_SCARCITY_OTHER; else branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V. When the degenerate branch's M-D1V-DEGENERACY-MODE is ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_COUPLING, EXECUTE also emits the secondary label FEASIBILITY-D1V-SINGLE-ANCHOR-TRANSPORT-COUPLED (the mandate's bounded-reason deliverable, bound to the passing estimator control). Report M-D1V-BLOCKER-{anchor}, M-TRANSPORT-BODY-DERIVATION-{anchor}, M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY-{anchor}, M-N-D1V-BLOCKED-ANCHORS. Part II is reported null with reason; no false-accept or blindness claim. Else if M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V >= 0.10 AND M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW > 0 => branch INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED (report M-FA-INCUMBENT-D1V and its UB97 as the explicit false-accept bound). Else => branch INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND (F-BLIND). GATE B branches do not change status/outcome. Status/outcome map: GATE C/GATE E/GATE F blocking failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE; C4 -> COMPLETE/INCONCLUSIVE; E3 fail -> COMPLETE/MIXED; D1 -> COMPLETE/SUPPORTS; D2 -> COMPLETE/FALSIFIES; D3 -> COMPLETE/MIXED.
